codeReview.summary: The implementation correctly addresses both security and multi-business issues. Security: POST /public/invitations/accept now requires authentication via contextPlugin and derives userId from the authenticated session (ctx.userId) instead of accepting client-supplied userId. The request body no longer includes userId. Multi-business: Both acceptInvitation() and createInvitation() now use findByUserIdAndBusinessId() to check membership for the specific businessId only, allowing users to join multiple businesses.

issues.description: contextPlugin throws plain Error('No autorizado') instead of UnauthorizedError when no session exists. This is inconsistent with middleware/auth.ts which uses throw new UnauthorizedError(). However, set.status = 401 is properly set before throwing, so the HTTP response will correctly return 401.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The worker correctly followed existing patterns: added contextPlugin and servicesPlugin to publicInvitationRoutes, used findByUserIdAndBusinessId for per-business membership checks, derived userId from session context.
